A different pace

There’s magic in the almost missed.

A curled fern. A fallen leaf with a story to tell. The tiny architecture of a mushroom after rain. Field Notes is an invitation to trade the rush for a ramble and meet the little things that make a forest feel alive.

A note from us

Take memories.
Leave the wild.

Our favourite way to forage is with our eyes. Photograph, draw, and observe without disturbing the places you visit. Never eat a wild mushroom based on a picture or a website: identification requires expert, local guidance.
